result.summary: A residential street with a dense tree canopy and sidewalks, providing a comfortable walking environment. However, the intersection lacks marked crosswalks and traffic control, and parked cars obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at the intersection, making pedestrian movements unpredictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and dense street-side vegetation may hide pedestrians, especially children, from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside along both sides of the street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

result.summary: The environment features sidewalks and mature trees providing a buffer, but the pedestrian crossing infrastructure is degraded. Faded crosswalk markings and the absence of dedicated pedestrian signals at a signalized intersection increase risk for people crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: There are no visible pedestrian-specific signal heads to indicate when it is safe to cross at this signalized intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility 'continental' or 'ladder' style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety at the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with faded crosswalk markings and mixed-use residential buildings. While traffic signals are present, the lack of clear pedestrian-oriented infrastructure like curb extensions or high-visibility markings increases exposure risk.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are significantly worn, making the pedestrian crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The large width of the intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside along the far right and left

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines by preventing parking too close to the corner.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that show the remaining time to cross, improving pedestrian decision-making and safety.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and mature street trees are present, the lack of visible pedestrian signals at the signalized intersection and potential sightline obstructions from vegetation are notable.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large street trees and parked vehicles near the intersection may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the intersection near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.
